Messages.Author: Mongrel Matt Hirsch
Messages.Body:
Can Agaitas' ability be used when you use a political action card as a
vote during another methuselah's referendum?

If you lose control of Agaitas, what happens to any face-up cards
currently in your hand?

Do face-up cards in hand remain face-up when traded around via
Succubus Club?

Thanks,

Matt Hirsch

mon...@hotpop.com

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mongrel Matt Hirsch wrote:
>
> Can Agaitas' ability be used when you use a political action card as a
> vote during another methuselah's referendum?

No, since the card is not replaced when played.

> If you lose control of Agaitas, what happens to any face-up cards
> currently in your hand?

They remain.

> Do face-up cards in hand remain face-up when traded around via
> Succubus Club?

Yes. The face-up card remains face-up until ultimately played or
discarded.
